questions.stem: A disabling ischemic stroke, two hours from last known well, no blood on the scan. Is there time for a clot-busting medicine?

options.text: No; the window is already closed
Yes; four and a half hours is the usual window
Only after an advanced scan delays the medicine
Never, if the stroke score is not high

questions.explanation: Do not delay for advanced pictures inside that window. A disabling deficit still counts.

questions.stem: A seizure has continued for several minutes. First medicine?

options.text: A phenytoin load only, and skip the first medicine
A benzodiazepine now
A migraine cocktail
Observation until it stops on its own

questions.explanation: The second drug comes after, not instead of, that first dose.

questions.stem: A headache that is maximal at the first second. First move?

options.text: A migraine cocktail, then home
A head scan now
A clinic visit in a month
A nitrate spray

questions.explanation: A thunderclap headache is a bleed until it is not.

questions.stem: A negative head scan six hours after a thunderclap headache, or a new deficit:

options.text: Always ends the workup
Is not enough; you still need spinal fluid or a vessel study
Means you give a lytic
Is treated as celiac disease

questions.explanation: Within six hours, with no new deficit, a negative scan can be enough.

questions.stem: In suspected bacterial meningitis, the steroid is given:

options.text: An hour after the antibiotic, as the plan
With, or just before, the first antibiotic
Never
Instead of the antibiotic

questions.explanation: Do not hang the antibiotic and remember the steroid an hour later.

questions.stem: A warning stroke that resolved is:

options.text: A cleared patient, safe for a visit in a month
Not a cleared patient; find the cause quickly
Proof that no thinner will ever be needed
A reason to skip a tracing

questions.explanation: Atrial fibrillation or a tight neck artery can still be hiding.

questions.stem: Inside four and a half hours, a disabling deficit:

options.text: Should wait for advanced pictures before any clot-busting medicine
Should not be delayed for advanced pictures
Is never treated if the score looks low
Is treated with flumazenil

questions.explanation: Either of the two approved medicines is acceptable. Doses were not the point of the video.

questions.stem: If a seizure continues after the first benzodiazepine, the next step is:

options.text: Another stack of tiny benzodiazepine doses only
One full dose of a second medicine
A migraine cocktail
Discharge

questions.explanation: Do not stack small benzodiazepine doses and call that treatment.

questions.stem: Low sugar, in a patient who looks like a stroke:

options.text: Can copy a stroke and should be checked first
Is treated with a clot-busting medicine immediately
Is ignored
Replaces the head scan later

questions.explanation: Check the sugar and a plain head scan first.

options.text: A clot-busting medicine for an eligible disabling ischemic stroke belongs inside 4.5 hours.
Status epilepticus gets a benzodiazepine first.
A resolved warning stroke can wait a month for clinic.
Give the meningitis steroid with, or before, the first antibiotic.

questions.explanation: A resolved warning stroke is not a cleared patient.
